description: This file contains a class 'ProfileReader' that implements the 'IProfileReader' interface to read user profile data from a database context, perform mapping, and handle related logic such as follow status determination.

classes.name: ProfileReader
classes.description: A class responsible for reading user profile information from the database, mapping entities to DTOs, and including follow status logic.

methods.name: ReadProfile
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a user's profile data by username, including their follow status relative to the current user.
